observation: On frozen fixtures 8KiB prefixes reduce six-source metadata GETs from12 to6 and many-small from32 to16, with identical transferred body bytes versus the optimized4KiB variant. Single-shot six-source latency does not improve materially, and cannot establish an overall speed gain. The root task owns a separate one-page TIFF byte-tradeoff test; this receipt does not assert its result.
